status: PRE-REGISTERED PLAN ONLY — no field data collected yet; no result claimed here
objective: Decide whether Route A (asr_vad_periodic_gate_enabled + asr_vad_periodic_recheck + ASR_VAD_THRESHOLD lowered) may replace the current default (Silero threshold 0.4 + recheck) as the on-device default, using REAL robot-microphone recordings and a named Raspberry Pi / ARM target.

comparison.same_engine: Both arms run the same LocalAsrEngine code path; only the VAD/gate settings differ. Same model.int8.onnx (SHA256 recorded).

data_requirements.must_be_real_recordings: Captured on the target robot microphone(s) in the deployment acoustic environment. Gain attenuation, synthetic reverb, and TTS are NOT acceptable substitutes for whisper/far-field.
conditions_required: quiet speech (low vocal effort, not attenuated)
sustained machine noise (fan, motor, vacuum-like, HVAC)
data_requirements.references: Human-verified transcripts. Model outputs, TTS sources, or model self-predictions must never be used as ground truth.
data_requirements.independence: Split by speaker AND by recording session/meeting where possible; train/development/final-test must not overlap by audio or text hash. If speaker/meeting identity cannot be verified, state explicitly that independence is unproven and treat CIs as lower bounds on uncertainty.
data_requirements.sizes: Pre-register target counts before recording; each speech condition should have enough utterances that the rare 'VAD-missed whole utterance' event is not carried by 1-2 samples (the 40-utterance batches were underpowered for this). Report achieved counts honestly.

measurements_required.speech: Per-condition CER, empty-transcript counts, and utterance/recording-grouped paired bootstrap 95% CI (candidate minus baseline).
measurements_required.non_speech: False-trigger counts SEPARATED into: real environmental noise, digital silence, background human speech, and any synthetic control — reported per category, not merged into one number.
measurements_required.per_recording: Per-recording or per-group breakdown with appropriate uncertainty; do not aggregate away a single bad microphone/session.
measurements_required.efficiency_on_target_arm_device: Model file size; steady-state process memory; cold-start time; per-utterance inference time; real-time factor (RTF); and added gate+recheck latency. All measured ON the named target device, not on the Apple Silicon dev machine.
measurements_required.device_naming: State the exact Raspberry Pi model / SoC / RAM and OS; do not generalize across devices.

acceptance_to_change_default.rule: Route A may be recommended as the new default ONLY if ALL of the following hold on the pre-registered real field test:
checks: no_clean_regression: speech CER (clean) <= baseline, and no clean utterance accepted by baseline becomes empty
quiet_farfield_no_regression: on quiet, whisper, and far-field conditions, speech CER <= baseline AND no lost speech vs baseline
improvement_or_significance: overall speech CER relative reduction >= 5%, OR the quiet/whisper subset paired 95% CI upper bound < 0
no_new_false_triggers: false triggers on real environmental noise, silence, background human speech, and sustained machine noise do not exceed baseline in any category
efficiency: peak RTF < 0.15 and cold-start / memory / added latency within the named device budget (budget fixed before the run)
reproducibility: model + config + data version/hashes recorded; references are human transcripts
acceptance_to_change_default.decision: If any check fails, keep the current default (0.4 + recheck) and record exactly which evidence is missing. Passing does not auto-apply; it only justifies a separate, explicit default-change change with its own review.

invalid_as_evidence: Gain-attenuated audio used to stand in for whisper or far-field (spectrum, reverb, and mic directivity differ).
Synthetic noise only, or ESC-50 controls reported as a real-world false-trigger rate.
Small samples (e.g. ~40 utterances) where the whole-utterance VAD-miss event is carried by 1-2 examples.
Model self-predictions or TTS as reference transcripts.
Apple Silicon timing/memory presented as Raspberry Pi numbers.

current_evidence_and_limits.route_A_evidence_so_far: On fresh held-out WenetSpeech meeting batches (gain-attenuation proxy), Route A improved CER at every condition and added no false positives on the tested controls; paired CI upper bound < 0 at x0.03/x0.01 but still touching 0 at clean/x0.1.
not_yet_validated: real whisper, far-field, reverb, and target-microphone directivity
sustained machine noise and background human speech
Raspberry Pi / ARM resource and latency
